The dimensions of a rectangular floor are $12\,\text{m}\times 3\,\text{m}$, where each dimension is measured to the nearest $1\,\text{m}.$ Rounded to the nearest square meter, what is the smallest possible area of the floor?

To the nearest square meter, the smallest possible area is
{{field-1}}${\text{m}}^{2}.$
